# RoarCAD

RoarCAD is a free, MIT-licensed, browser-based PCB review and collaboration workbench for people and AI agents.

Canonical URL: https://roarcad.netlify.app/
Source: https://github.com/jongan69/RoarCAD
Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/roarcad

## Product boundaries

- AI tools can draft, inspect, preview changes, and prepare validated exports.
- AI tools cannot apply a design change, download files, order boards, pay, or approve evidence.
- A visible human action creates every new revision and starts every manufacturing action.
- An engineering export is not proof that a physical board will work.
- PocketRoar is an engineering study, not a fabrication-ready or physically validated product.
